radar.intro: Every flag below comes from a written rule and your saved records. No predictions, no scores about people.
radar.flagsIntro: Each item says what was measured and which rule it broke.
rule.LONG_SHIFT: Rule: a shift longer than {limit} h (maximum shift length).
rule.WEEKLY_HOURS: Rule: more than {limit} h in any 7 days (weekly limit).
flag.SHORT_REST: {name}: only {value} h rest between two shifts
rule.SHORT_REST: Rule: at least {limit} h rest between shifts.
flag.NO_WEEKLY_OFF: {name}: {value} days in a row without a day off
rule.NO_WEEKLY_OFF: Rule: no more than {limit} working days in a row.
flag.MISSING_CHECKOUT: {name}: no check-out for the shift on {day}
rule.MISSING_CHECKOUT: Rule: a shift still open after {limit} h is a missing check-out. It is not paid until someone corrects it.
flag.BELOW_MIN_WAGE: {name}: daily rate {value} is below the minimum {limit}
rule.BELOW_MIN_WAGE: Rule: the daily rate (wage ÷ working days) must meet the minimum daily wage set for this workplace.
flag.PAY_DISPUTE_OPEN: Pay dispute {ref} ({title}) is waiting for a decision
rule.PAY_DISPUTE_OPEN: Rule: every open pay dispute stays on this list until it is resolved. Opened {value} h ago.
rule.CRITICAL_OPEN: Rule: a report that mentions injury or immediate danger is marked critical.
flag.CASE_REOPENED: {ref} ({title}): the worker said the fix did not work
rule.CASE_REOPENED: Rule: a reopened case needs a new resolution. Reopened {value}×.
rule.CASE_OVERDUE.ack: Rule: {type} marked {severity} must be acknowledged within {limit} h. Escalated to {to}.
rule.CASE_OVERDUE.resolve: Rule: {type} marked {severity} must be resolved within {limit} h. Escalated to {to}.
rule.CASE_OVERDUE.ack.pay: Rule: pay disputes must be acknowledged within {limit} h. Escalated to {to}.
rule.CASE_OVERDUE.resolve.pay: Rule: pay disputes must be resolved within {limit} h. Escalated to {to}.
